raw.headline: Household lacks sufficient backup for 175-hour outage.
raw.decision: Leave for a powered location before the storm because current backup (0 h for insulin, unknown for CPAP) cannot cover the 175-hour outage.

items.requirement: Ensure DC converter and deep-cycle battery are installed and functional.
items.gap: Cannot verify if battery lasts through 175-hour outage.
actions: Test converter output matches 24 V, 3.75 A specification.
Charge the deep-cycle battery fully before the storm arrives.
Confirm battery rating supports CPAP runtime; note vehicle reserve limits.

items.requirement: Have a powered cooler or ice packs ready before the power goes out.
items.gap: No backup power; fridge will warm during 175-hour outage.
actions: Obtain an insulated cooler large enough for insulin storage.
Pre-freeze ice packs and keep them in the cooler.
Monitor temperature regularly with a thermometer inside the cooler.

missing.why: To provide electricity for CPAP and fridge during extended outage.
missing.action: Purchase, test, and store fuel safely according to manufacturer instructions.

priority.text: Obtain insulated cooler, pre-freeze ice packs, monitor temperature.
